title: Mid-Year School Holiday Family Experience Campaign
objective: Drive family bookings and foot traffic to hospitality venues (hotels, resorts, dining) during Singapore/international school holidays (July) by positioning Myanmar as the 'cultural adventure escape' for families with children aged 5–16.
target_audience: Middle to upper-middle-class families in Singapore, Thailand, and Yangon; parents aged 30–50 with disposable income; school-holiday planners on Facebook and Instagram.
key_activities: 3 hero campaign videos (60s each) featuring family moments at iconic Myanmar temples, local markets, and resort experiences; production-led by ZYNTH (script/concept/direction), shot on-location in Yangon and Mandalay.

6-week organic social content calendar: 24 Instagram Reels + 18 Facebook carousel posts showcasing real family itineraries, kid-friendly activities, local cuisine, and testimonial clips from past guests.
Influencer partnership with 4 family travel micro-influencers (50–150K followers across SG/TH) producing 8 UGC-style Instagram Stories and 4 TikTok videos; 2-week content deliverable.
Paid social campaign (Meta + TikTok): 3 audience segments (budget-conscious families, premium planners, adventure seekers), A/B tested creatives, 4-week run with daily optimization.
Email nurture sequence (5 emails, 2-week cadence) to hotel/resort CRM: family package upsells, early-bird discounts, exclusive activities.
Weekly performance dashboard (impressions, engagements, website clicks, booking-form submissions).
kpis: 2,500 website clicks from social (UTM tracking)
850 email opens, 12% conversion to booking inquiry
650,000 total impressions (organic + paid combined)
4.2% overall engagement rate (target: 3–5%)
45 qualified family booking leads (form submissions)
22% increase in July bookings YoY vs. July 2025 (baseline)

Influencer Marketing (4 micro-influencers, 12 pieces)

why_now: July is peak school-holiday season in Singapore, Thailand, and international schools. Families actively search for 'kid-friendly Asia destinations' 4–6 weeks before travel. Myanmar hospitality venues see 30–40% booking spikes during this window. A coordinated social + influencer push now captures high-intent planners before competitor destinations saturate the feed.

title: Luxury Resort Grand Reopening & Soft Launch Event
objective: Execute a high-impact soft-launch event for a newly renovated 5-star resort (150 pax, VIP media + influencers + past guests) to generate PR buzz, social proof, and immediate post-renovation booking momentum.
target_audience: Luxury travel media (journalists, bloggers), A-list travel influencers (100K+ followers), affluent past guests (high-lifetime-value list), Myanmar business elite, and international expat community in Yangon.
key_activities: Full event production: venue setup (resort ballroom or garden), stage design with brand refresh visuals (new logo, color palette), 5-course gala dinner, welcome cocktail, resort tour stations.
Media relations: press release (English + Burmese), media kit (hi-res photos, renovation story), confirmed attendance from 8–12 media outlets and 6–8 travel influencers (minimum 50K followers each).
Live photography + 4K event videography: 300+ edited photos (5-day turnaround), 1 x 4-minute cinematic event recap video (ZYNTH-produced), 8 x 15–30s Instagram Reels from event moments.

Influencer activations: 3 designated photo-op zones (resort garden, new spa entrance, signature restaurant corner) with custom branded backdrops and props; each influencer produces 6–10 Stories + 2–3 feed posts.
Post-event content push: 6 curated Instagram carousel posts, 12 TikTok videos (influencer + ZYNTH-edited highlights), 1 press release distribution (Myanmar News Agency, industry publications).
Real-time social listening & engagement: monitor hashtag #ResortReborn (or custom event hashtag) for 7 days post-event.
kpis: 150 confirmed attendees (min 85% show rate = 128 guests)
8–12 media placements (online articles, print, broadcast mentions within 14 days post-event)
850,000 combined impressions from influencer + organic social (7 days post-event)
6.8% engagement rate on event-related posts (above 3–5% industry benchmark)
28 qualified booking inquiries (tracked via 'attended event' segment in CRM)
8 pieces of UGC from influencers (Stories + feed posts minimum)
1.2M reach via earned media (PR placements valued at ~MMK 15–20M equivalent advertising)
Post-event NPS score ≥ 8.5/10 from attendees (survey)

title: Monsoon-Season Staycation Flash Campaign (Weekend Escape Promotion)
objective: Convert hesitant Yangon urban professionals (expats + affluent locals) into weekend staycation bookers during July's rainy season by positioning domestic tourism as a 'guilt-free, accessible escape' and driving 180+ qualified bookings within 4 weeks.
target_audience: Yangon-based professionals aged 28–45, household income MMK 5M+/month; families planning last-minute weekend getaways; corporate team-building planners; active on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn; seekers of 'rainy-season relaxation' content.
key_activities: Paid search campaign (Google Ads): 8 high-intent keywords ('Yangon weekend hotel deals', 'monsoon staycation Myanmar', 'last-minute resort booking', etc.), dynamic landing pages with 3 audience variants (families, couples, teams), 3-week run with daily bid management.

Social media blitz: 16 TikTok + Reels (8–15s format, rain ambience, cozy-hotel aesthetics, stress-relief messaging), 12 Facebook carousel ads (package highlights, pricing tiers, urgency copy), 6 LinkedIn posts (team-building angle, corporate rates).
Email campaign: 2 triggered email sequences (website visitor retargeting + CRM audience), 4 promotional emails (3-day, 5-day, 7-day pre-launch pushes, final 'last 2 days' urgency), SMS if opted-in.
Influencer micro-burst: 3 x Yangon-based lifestyle micro-influencers (20–80K followers) produce 3 x TikTok videos (real staycation experience, monsoon vibes) + 6 x Instagram Stories over 10 days.
Landing page A/B test: Version A (emotional copy, 'escape the rain'), Version B (rational copy, '% discount + free WiFi'), measure conversion rate (target 4–6%).
Booking-page optimization: simplified checkout, payment gateway integration, instant confirmation SMS.
kpis: 180 qualified bookings (tracked via booking confirmation + payment gateway)
6.2% landing-page conversion rate (Version A vs. Version B tested)
2,400 clicks from Google Ads (target CPC MMK 4,000–6,000; total ad spend MMK 8–12M)
1.8M combined impressions (paid social + search, 4-week run)
5.4% click-through rate on social ads (above 1–3% baseline for hospitality)
42 email-driven conversions (6.8% CTR from promotional emails)
3.2% SMS conversion rate (if SMS push active)
Average booking value MMK 2.8M (package + add-ons; revenue target MMK 500M+)
Customer acquisition cost (CAC) ≤ MMK 50,000 per booking

Content Creation (16 Reels/TikToks, 12 carousel ad creatives, 6 LinkedIn posts)
Email Marketing (4 promotional sequences, triggered journeys)

Website/Landing Page Optimization (A/B testing, checkout UX)
why_now: July monsoon creates psychological urgency for indoor relaxation + last-minute weekend plans. Yangon professionals book staycations 5–10 days in advance. School holidays (SG/TH expat families) also drive demand. Hotels have mid-July inventory availability; a 4-week sprint from early July captures the 'rainy weekend' booking window before August (back-to-school).

Final campaign report (4 weeks total: traffic, conversions, revenue, CAC analysis, A/B test results)

title: Wellness Retreat Brand Refresh & Influencer Takeover Activation
objective: Reposition an established but stale wellness resort brand as 'Myanmar's modern wellness destination' by partnering with 5 wellness + travel influencers (80K–250K followers across SG/MM/TH) for a 10-day immersive content takeover, generating 140+ authentic pieces of content, 2.1M+ impressions, and 320+ qualified wellness-retreat inquiries.
target_audience: Wellness-conscious women aged 28–50, yoga/meditation practitioners, sustainable-travel enthusiasts, affluent SG/TH expatriates in Yangon, Instagram-native wellness community (hashtag #MyanmarWellness, #YogaRetreatMM); secondary: corporate wellness coordinators (B2B team retreats).
key_activities: Influencer selection & partnership: 5 influencers (mix of yoga teachers, wellness bloggers, lifestyle travel creators) from Singapore, Thailand, and Myanmar (80K–250K followers, high engagement). 10-day hosted retreat (early July), all-inclusive package (accommodation, meals, activities, travel).

Pre-retreat briefing: ZYNTH works with resort to define 3 content pillars ('transformative yoga journey', 'sustainable wellness practices', 'Yangon culture integration'), share 12 optional content prompts, approve aesthetic/tone guidelines.

On-site content production: ZYNTH-embedded producer (or coordinated remotely with resort) ensures daily content capture: 5 influencers produce minimum 28 posts total (5–6 per creator) across Instagram feed/Stories/Reels + 8 TikTok videos (group activities, sunrise yoga, local excursions, testimonial clips).

Behind-the-scenes ZYNTH content: 1 x 90-second 'influencer retreat vlog' teaser, 6 x curator-style Instagram Reels ('day 1 arrival', 'sunrise yoga flow', 'local market visit', etc.), 3 x TikTok compilations (trending audio mashups).
Post-retreat narrative: curated gallery of 100+ influencer-tagged photos, 1 x blog post (lifestyle media outreach), 4-week hashtag monitoring (#MyanmarWellness, #WellnessRetreatMM).
Booking-inquiry tracking: UTM links, promo codes per influencer, dedicated landing page, email capture.

title: Hotel Chain 'Peak Season Prep' Multi-Property Campaign & Corporate Partnerships
objective: Generate 85+ qualified corporate booking leads (team stays, training events, incentive trips) and corporate partnership opportunities for a 3-property Myanmar hotel chain by positioning July as 'strategic planning season' and driving B2B awareness via targeted LinkedIn + email outreach, positioning the 3 hotels as a unified 'corporate retreat ecosystem'.
target_audience: Corporate HR managers, event coordinators, and C-suite decision-makers (Myanmar & Singapore) at mid-to-large companies (100–1,000+ employees); budget delegates for team-building, training, and incentive programs; LinkedIn-active, email-responsive, planning Q3–Q4 events.
key_activities: B2B prospect research & list building: ZYNTH NOVA team identifies 300+ qualified prospects (company name, decision-maker title, verified email/LinkedIn) across Myanmar + Singapore; lead-score each 0–100 (budget signal, event history, growth indicators). Target ≥ 200 @ score 60+.

LinkedIn multi-touch campaign: 6 x LinkedIn carousel posts (hotel facilities, testimonials, case studies) + 8 x LinkedIn direct outreach sequences (personalized connection requests → 3-email nurture → demo calendar link). Track opens, clicks, profile visits.

Email outreach: ZYNTH copywriter produces 4 email sequences (15–20 personalized variants each, using prospect company name/role/industry signals). Cadence: welcome → value prop → case study → limited-time offer. Send over 3 weeks; track opens (target 32%), clicks (18%), replies (6%).
Lead magnet: 1 x downloadable guide ('Corporate Retreat ROI: 5-Property Benchmarking Study') + case studies (3 past hotel event successes) locked behind email capture → nurture triggered.
Sales enablement: Sales deck (customizable by property + group size), rate card by group size/season, proposal template (ZYNTH Proposal Writer handles custom quotes).
Event landing page: dedicated site with property photos, video tour (2 min), group rates, inquiry form (feeds CRM), calendar booking (demo call, site visit scheduling).
kpis: 85 qualified corporate leads (defined as: completed inquiry form + identified decision-maker + stated group size 20+)
32% email open rate (above 22% hospitality B2B benchmark)
18% email click-through rate (above 5% benchmark)
6% reply rate from outreach (qualified interest signal)
420 LinkedIn profile visits from outreach sequence
4.2% LinkedIn CTR on carousel posts (above 1–2% benchmark)
28 qualified demo calls scheduled (on calendar, confirmed attendee)
18 site visits booked (property tours with decision-makers)

6 signed bookings (corporate team stays, training events, incentive trips; avg. value MMK 12M per booking = MMK 72M+ revenue)
